availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: user:docs
availableCommands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached.

# Review candidate

Read-only. Do not repair or start another review.

## Specification
### P2.7 — Схема 0.3 и upgrade-миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9

**Intent:** Свежая установка создаёт таблицы и колонки в каноне OPUS 03 §7/08 §2 (в части P2) без feature-гейтов, а
база 0.2 (фикстура P0.3) доходит до той же схемы upgrade-миграциями №1, №2, №4, №8, №9 с сохранением данных; код всех
пакетов читает канонические таблицы/колонки, `EventType` получает канонические значения 03 §8 вместе с миграцией
сохранённых событий и подписок (D16, R7–R10).

**Why:** OPUS 13 P2.1 (миграции 2, 4, 8, 9 и preflight 1; V15 частично), 08 §2–§3, 03 §7–§8, 04 §2 («таблицы создаются
независимо от установленных модулей»), N28. Код `main` @ `938f0ea`: `PanelTablesBuilder.php:1249–1257` гейтит таблицы
флагами; `Support\Config::table()` (`Config.php:849`) применяет `vaulter.table_names`; `v_storages.panel`/`v_nodes.panel`
(`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1184`), `storage_id` в `nodes`/`blobs`/`upload_sessions`/`activity`; события хранятся строками в
`v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`, `v_webhook_endpoints.events` (строки 737, 799, 826, 848).

**Scope Included:**
1. Целевая схема в `Schema\SchemaBuilder` (fresh): сущности `drives` (было `storages`), `file_revisions`,
   `file_revision_blobs`; таблица `v_drives` по 08 §2: `profile` varchar(64) default `'default'` (было `panel`),
   `status` как сейчас (набор значений `active|archived|deleting` — P4.6), удалены `storage_type`, `slug`,
   `default_node_permissions`, `deleted_at`; индексы `UNIQUE(owner_type, owner_id, profile)`, `(profile, status)`, `(tenant_id)`; `v_nodes`: `drive_id` (было `storage_id`), `profile` (было
   `panel`, R17); `v_blobs.drive_id`; `v_files.current_revision_id`, `revision_count`, без `deleted_at`;
   `v_file_revisions`: `number` (было `version_no`), `sha256` (было `content_sha256`), `declared_mime_type varchar(191) null`,
   `scan_status varchar(16) not null default 'not_required'`, `UNIQUE(file_id, number)`; `v_file_revision_blobs.file_revision_id`;
   `v_node_grants` без `deleted_at`, `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`, обычный `UNIQUE(node_id, subject_type, subject_id, scope, effect)`
   (без MySQL `grant_active`); `v_node_shares` без `deleted_at`; `v_upload_sessions`: `drive_id`, `target_node_id` (было
   `node_id`), `result_node_id` REF null, `result_revision_id` REF null; `v_activity`: `drive_id`, `event_id varchar(26) null`
   (индекс); `v_outbox`: `drive_id` REF null, `aggregate_type varchar(32) null`, `aggregate_id varchar(64) null`,
   `sequence bigint null`. Имена индексов/FK, содержащие `storage`/`version`, получают `drive`/`revision`.
   Feature-гейты таблиц (`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1244–1260`) и проверка `extra_data` для таблиц удаляются: все таблицы
   создаются всегда (04 §2); `v_nodes.extra` остаётся под флагом `extra_data` до P4.1. Без изменений: `v_nodes.owner_id`,
   `current_version_id`, `file_id`, `deleted_at`, `v_node_document_versions` (P4.1).
2. Базовые миграции (R8): `2026_06_13_000007…000022` не переименовываются; `up()` → `(new SchemaBuilder)->createTable('<канон>')`
   без feature-проверок (`000021`/`000022` больше не читают `featureEnabled`); `down()` — `dropTable`. Миграции P1
   `2026_10_01_000003/000006/000007` переходят на канонические ключи (`drives`, `file_revisions`, …, колонки `drive_id`).
3. `Support\Config`: `table(string $name)` = префикс + `$name` (без `table_names`); новый
   `legacyTable(string $legacyEntity): string` = префикс + (`vaulter.table_names.<legacyEntity>` или `$legacyEntity`) — только
   для upgrade-миграций (R9). Ключи `table_names` в `config/vaulter.php` остаются до P2.5.
4. `2026_10_01_000001_vaulter_preflight.php` (`up()` только проверяет; `down()` пустой): выполняется, если существует
   `legacyTable('storages')` и нет `table('drives')` (иначе no-op). Отказ `Vaulter\Exceptions\Schema\UpgradePreflightException`
   (new, extends `VaulterException`, код `upgrade_preflight_failed`) с перечнем найденного и подсказкой
   `php artisan vaulter:upgrade:inspect` (команда — P7), если: (a) `v_nodes.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (кол-во);
   (b) узлы `kind = 'document'` без строк в `legacyTable('node_document_versions')` (или таблицы нет при наличии документов);
   (c) own-tables: таблица, имя которой оканчивается на `storages` и не равно `legacyTable('storages')` (`Schema::getTables()`);
   (d) `v_storages.deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; (e) `v_files.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (R18: удаление колонок воскресило бы
   soft-deleted строки). Бэкап — требование `UPGRADE.md`; подтверждение — стандартный `migrate --force` в production (R18).
5. `…000002_rename_storages_to_drives.php` (каждый шаг проверяет состояние до выполнения):
   (a) каждая сущность из устаревшей `vaulter.table_names` с нестандартным именем → `RENAME` в `<prefix><сущность 0.2>`;
   (b) `storages` → `drives`; `panel` → `profile` в `v_drives` и `v_nodes`; `storage_id` → `drive_id` в `v_nodes`, `v_blobs`,
   `v_upload_sessions`, `v_activity`; переименование индексов/FK до имён `SchemaBuilder`;
   (c) удалить `v_drives.{storage_type, slug, default_node_permissions, deleted_at}` и зависимые индексы, создать индексы п.1;
   (d) создать отсутствующие таблицы ядра (ранее выключенные флагами 0.2) через `SchemaBuilder::createTable()`.
   `down()`: обратные переименования; удалённые колонки возвращаются с дефолтами 0.2 (`storage_type 'private'`,
   `slug null`, `default_node_permissions 31`, `deleted_at null`) — значения потеряны (UPGRADE.md); таблицы шага (d) не удаляются.
6. `…000004_file_revisions.php`: `file_versions` → `file_revisions` (`version_no` → `number`, `content_sha256` → `sha256`,
   + `declared_mime_type`, `scan_status` = `'not_required'` для существующих строк); `file_version_blobs` → `file_revision_blobs`
   (`file_version_id` → `file_revision_id`, PK/FK); `v_files`: `current_version_id` → `current_revision_id`,
   `version_count` → `revision_count`, удалить `deleted_at`; `v_upload_sessions`: `node_id` → `target_node_id`,
   + `result_node_id`, `result_revision_id` (тип REF по `ids.default`). `down()` — обратно.
7. `…000008_grants_shares_cleanup.php`: `DELETE` grants с `deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; shares:
   `revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, deleted_at)`; удалить `deleted_at` (оба), `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`;
   PG — снять частичный unique, MySQL — `grant_active` и его unique; создать обычный unique п.1. `down()` возвращает
   колонки (`deleted_at null`, `inherited false`) и прежние уникальности; удалённые grants не восстанавливаются (UPGRADE.md).
8. `…000009_events.php` + значения `EventType` (R7, R10): карта `storage.created→drive.created`, `node.created→folder.created`,
   `version.created→file.revision_added`, `node.force_deleted→node.purged`, `upload_session.{initiated,aborted,expired}→upload.{…}`;
   `UPDATE` `v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`; `v_webhook_endpoints.events` — PHP-цикл
   чанками по 500 (JSON-список, порядок и дубликаты сохраняются); колонки п.1 для `v_activity`/`v_outbox`. `down()` —
   обратная карта и удаление колонок. В `EventType` значения case → канонические (`DriveCreated='drive.created'`, …).
9. Код всех пакетов: таблицы через `Config::table('<канон>')`, атрибуты/связи/запросы — канонические колонки
   (`storage_id`→`drive_id` в `src`/`tests`/factories, `version_no`→`number`, `content_sha256`→`sha256`,
   `current_version_id`→`current_revision_id` для `File`, `version_count`→`revision_count`, `file_version_id`→`file_revision_id`,
   `node_id`→`target_node_id` для `UploadSession`, `panel`→`profile`); `Profile::storageType()/storageTypeKey()` удаляются.
   HTTP-ответы и входы сохраняют прежние JSON-ключи (`storage_id`, `version_no`, …) до P6.1 (R19): ресурс отдаёт
   `'storage_id' => $this->drive_id`.
10. Тесты (`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/`, `uses(TestCase::class)` как у P1.7, PG; пропуск без pgsql или `psql`):
    - `Canon03UpgradeTest.php` — для `pgsql-bigint.sql` и `pgsql-ulid.sql`: загрузка (`LoadsV02Fixture`), `migrate --force` →
      успех; числа строк: `v_drives=3`, `v_nodes=40`, `v_files=16`, `v_file_revisions=22`, `v_file_revision_blobs=22`,
      `v_node_grants=3` (5 − 2 soft-deleted), `v_node_shares=4` (у soft-deleted `revoked_at = deleted_at`), `v_activity=72`,
      `v_outbox=68`, `v_webhook_deliveries=4`, `v_webhook_endpoints=1`; ни одного старого значения события в четырёх
      колонках п.8; `owner_id` строки `1,2,3`/три ULID README; `v_file_revisions.number` файла `q1.csv` = 1,2,3;
      `scan_status = 'not_required'` у всех; повторный `migrate` — no-op; `migrate:rollback --step=5` возвращает
      `v_storages` и прежние значения событий; повторный `migrate` снова зелёный.
    - `UpgradePreflightTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint-preflight-red.sql` → `migrate` падает с `UpgradePreflightException`, сообщение
      содержит `gone.txt`-счётчик, `Headless`, `vlegacy_storages`; таблицы не переименованы; случаи (d)/(e) — raw `UPDATE`
      поверх `pgsql-bigint.sql`.
    - `LegacyTableNamesUpgradeTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint.sql` + `ALTER TABLE v_nodes RENAME TO v_custom_nodes` и
      `vaulter.table_names.nodes = 'custom_nodes'` → после `migrate` существует `v_nodes`, строк 40.
    - `SchemaParityTest.php` — схема после upgrade каждого дампа = схема fresh `migrate` той же стратегии (колонки, типы,
      nullable, default, имена и столбцы индексов/unique/FK; порядок колонок не сравнивается). Расхождения, существовавшие
      до P2.7 (замер на дереве P2.1), — `artifacts/P2.7/parity-baseline.txt`; P2.7 не добавляет новых и устраняет все на
      затронутых колонках.
    - Fresh на MySQL: `packages/core/tests/Schema/CanonicalSchemaTest.php` — после `migrate` существуют `v_drives`,
      `v_file_revisions`, `v_file_revision_blobs`, колонки п.1 и unique grants; нет `v_storages`, `grant_active`.
11. Документация: `UPGRADE.md` (миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9, необратимые шаги, бэкап, карта событий для подписчиков
    webhooks), `CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]`, `docs/guide/{database-compatibility,configuration,webhooks}.md`; golden
    `PublicApiSnapshotTest` (`EventType` значения, `UpgradePreflightException`, `Config::legacyTable`).

**Scope Excluded:** миграции №5, №6 (кроме ссылок п.2), `v_documents`, `v_document_revisions`, `owned_by`, `sequence`,
удаление `v_nodes.{current_version_id,file_id,deleted_at}` (P4.1, P4.7); `v_drives.status` (P4.6); заполнение
`declared_mime_type`/`scan_status` (P3.7), outbox-колонок (P5.1); новые типы событий (P5.2); JSON-ключи REST (P6.1);
`vaulter:upgrade:inspect`, doctor, `drives:recount` (P7); MySQL-upgrade 0.2 (данных 0.2 на MySQL нет — D09).

**Inputs:** `plans/2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE/artifacts/P2-design/P2.7-opus.md`;
`audits/2026-09-29-stable-audit/opus/08-data-model-and-migration.md` (§2, §3); `packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php` (producer: P2.1); `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000006_nodes_cleanup.php`; `tests/fixtures/v0.2.0/README.md` (producer: P0.3);
`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/LoadsV02Fixture.php` (producer: P1.7).

**Files:** `packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php`, `packages/core/src/Support/Config.php`, `packages/core/src/Enums/Events/EventType.php`,
`packages/core/src/Exceptions/Schema/UpgradePreflightException.php` (new), `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_06_13_0000{07..22}_*.php`,
`packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_00000{1,2,4,8,9}_*.php` (new), `…_000003/000006/000007_*.php`,
`packages/{core,drive,documents,media,filament}/{src,tests,database}/**` (имена таблиц/колонок, значения событий),
`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/{Canon03UpgradeTest,UpgradePreflightTest,LegacyTableNamesUpgradeTest,SchemaParityTest}.php` (new),
`packages/core/tests/Schema/CanonicalSchemaTest.php` (new), `packages/core/tests/TablePrefix/TablePrefixTest.php`,
`artifacts/P2.7/parity-baseline.txt` (new), `packages/core/tests/Arch/__snapshots__/*`, `docs/guide/*.md`, `UPGRADE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

**Required Reads:** 0) `plans/2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE/artifacts/P2-design/P2.7-opus.md` (дословные требования OPUS — исполнить все,
кроме переданных по `note` ledger); 1) `packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php` (producer: P2.1; `defineStorages`…`defineWebhookDeliveries`,
уникальности 1020–1130, гейты 1240–1260); 2) `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000006_nodes_cleanup.php` (стиль
идемпотентной миграции P1); 3) `packages/core/tests/Upgrade/LoadsV02Fixture.php`; 4) `tests/fixtures/v0.2.0/README.md`;
5) `packages/core/src/Support/Config.php` (840–860); 6) `packages/core/src/Enums/Events/EventType.php` (producer: P2.1).

**Authority:** routine

**Implementation Rules:**
- Каждый шаг миграции проверяет состояние (`Schema::hasTable/hasColumn`, `getIndexes`, `getForeignKeys`) до выполнения;
  повтор после падения посередине доходит до конца (MySQL DDL не транзакционен).
- Данные не теряются, кроме перечисленного в UPGRADE.md (hard-delete soft-deleted grants; колонки `slug`, `storage_type`,
  `default_node_permissions`); любая другая потеря — красный item.
- Значения событий меняются только вместе с миграцией №9 (R7): нет промежуточного состояния, где код пишет новые
  значения, а данные — старые.
- `table_names` не используется нигде, кроме `Config::legacyTable()`.
- Если `SchemaParityTest` показывает расхождение вне `parity-baseline.txt`, которое нельзя устранить без изменения
  шага OPUS, — стоп и эскалация.

**Code Guidance:** остатки в коде (ожидаемый вывод пуст):
`grep -rnE "'storage_id'|->storage_id|'version_no'|'content_sha256'|'file_version_id'|'current_version_id'|'version_count'|Config::table\('(storages|file_versions|file_version_blobs)'\)|table_names" packages/*/src packages/*/database | grep -v "Support/Config.php" | grep -v "Http/Resources" | grep -v "Models/Drive/Node.php"`
(исключения: `legacyTable`, JSON-ключи ресурсов R19 и `v_nodes.current_version_id` до P4.1 — по одному обоснованному
совпадению на файл, перечисленному в Completion Notes).

**Validation:**
- Code Guidance → пусто (кроме перечисленных исключений).
- `env $PG scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci packages/core/tests/Upgrade packages/core/tests/Schema` → 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `env $MY scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci packages/core/tests/Schema/CanonicalSchemaTest.php` → 0 failed (падение,
  воспроизводимое на дереве P2.1 без изменений P2.7, — finding с владельцем P8.1, как правило MySQL P1.7).
- Сетка P1 на PG → 0 failed, 0 skipped; гейт всех пакетов → exit 0.
- Негативные контроли: (1) убрать `UPDATE … v_webhook_endpoints` из №9 → `Canon03UpgradeTest` красный (старое значение в
  подписке); (2) убрать проверку (a) из preflight → `UpgradePreflightTest` красный; вернуть оба.

**Deliverables:** целевая схема P2 без feature-гейтов; миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9; канонические значения `EventType`;
`Config::legacyTable`; тесты upgrade/parity/preflight на фикстуре P0.3; UPGRADE/CHANGELOG/docs/golden.

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

1→### P2.7 — Схема 0.3 и upgrade-миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9

**Intent:** Свежая установка создаёт таблицы и колонки в каноне OPUS 03 §7/08 §2 (в части P2) без feature-гейтов, а
база 0.2 (фикстура P0.3) доходит до той же схемы upgrade-миграциями №1, №2, №4, №8, №9 с сохранением данных; код всех
пакетов читает канонические таблицы/колонки, `EventType` получает канонические значения 03 §8 вместе с миграцией
сохранённых событий и подписок (D16, R7–R10).

**Why:** OPUS 13 P2.1 (миграции 2, 4, 8, 9 и preflight 1; V15 частично), 08 §2–§3, 03 §7–§8, 04 §2 («таблицы создаются
независимо от установленных модулей»), N28. Код `main` @ `938f0ea`: `PanelTablesBuilder.php:1249–1257` гейтит таблицы
10→флагами; `Support\Config::table()` (`Config.php:849`) применяет `vaulter.table_names`; `v_storages.panel`/`v_nodes.panel`
(`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1184`), `storage_id` в `nodes`/`blobs`/`upload_sessions`/`activity`; события хранятся строками в
`v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`, `v_webhook_endpoints.events` (строки 737, 799, 826, 848).

**Scope Included:**
1. Целевая схема в `Schema\SchemaBuilder` (fresh): сущности `drives` (было `storages`), `file_revisions`,
   `file_revision_blobs`; таблица `v_drives` по 08 §2: `profile` varchar(64) default `'default'` (было `panel`),
   `status` как сейчас (набор значений `active|archived|deleting` — P4.6), удалены `storage_type`, `slug`,
   `default_node_permissions`, `deleted_at`; индексы `UNIQUE(owner_type, owner_id, profile)`, `(profile, status)`, `(tenant_id)`; `v_nodes`: `drive_id` (было `storage_id`), `profile` (было
   `panel`, R17); `v_blobs.drive_id`; `v_files.current_revision_id`, `revision_count`, без `deleted_at`;
20→   `v_file_revisions`: `number` (было `version_no`), `sha256` (было `content_sha256`), `declared_mime_type varchar(191) null`,
   `scan_status varchar(16) not null default 'not_required'`, `UNIQUE(file_id, number)`; `v_file_revision_blobs.file_revision_id`;
   `v_node_grants` без `deleted_at`, `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`, обычный `UNIQUE(node_id, subject_type, subject_id, scope, effect)`
   (без MySQL `grant_active`); `v_node_shares` без `deleted_at`; `v_upload_sessions`: `drive_id`, `target_node_id` (было
   `node_id`), `result_node_id` REF null, `result_revision_id` REF null; `v_activity`: `drive_id`, `event_id varchar(26) null`
   (индекс); `v_outbox`: `drive_id` REF null, `aggregate_type varchar(32) null`, `aggregate_id varchar(64) null`,
   `sequence bigint null`. Имена индексов/FK, содержащие `storage`/`version`, получают `drive`/`revision`.
   Feature-гейты таблиц (`PanelTablesBuilder.php:1244–1260`) и проверка `extra_data` для таблиц удаляются: все таблицы
   создаются всегда (04 §2); `v_nodes.extra` остаётся под флагом `extra_data` до P4.1. Без изменений: `v_nodes.owner_id`,
   `current_version_id`, `file_id`, `deleted_at`, `v_node_document_versions` (P4.1).
30→2. Базовые миграции (R8): `2026_06_13_000007…000022` не переименовываются; `up()` → `(new SchemaBuilder)->createTable('<канон>')`
   без feature-проверок (`000021`/`000022` больше не читают `featureEnabled`); `down()` — `dropTable`. Миграции P1
   `2026_10_01_000003/000006/000007` переходят на канонические ключи (`drives`, `file_revisions`, …, колонки `drive_id`).
3. `Support\Config`: `table(string $name)` = префикс + `$name` (без `table_names`); новый
   `legacyTable(string $legacyEntity): string` = префикс + (`vaulter.table_names.<legacyEntity>` или `$legacyEntity`) — только
   для upgrade-миграций (R9). Ключи `table_names` в `config/vaulter.php` остаются до P2.5.
4. `2026_10_01_000001_vaulter_preflight.php` (`up()` только проверяет; `down()` пустой): выполняется, если существует
   `legacyTable('storages')` и нет `table('drives')` (иначе no-op). Отказ `Vaulter\Exceptions\Schema\UpgradePreflightException`
   (new, extends `VaulterException`, код `upgrade_preflight_failed`) с перечнем найденного и подсказкой
   `php artisan vaulter:upgrade:inspect` (команда — P7), если: (a) `v_nodes.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (кол-во);
40→   (b) узлы `kind = 'document'` без строк в `legacyTable('node_document_versions')` (или таблицы нет при наличии документов);
   (c) own-tables: таблица, имя которой оканчивается на `storages` и не равно `legacyTable('storages')` (`Schema::getTables()`);
   (d) `v_storages.deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; (e) `v_files.deleted_at IS NOT NULL` (R18: удаление колонок воскресило бы
   soft-deleted строки). Бэкап — требование `UPGRADE.md`; подтверждение — стандартный `migrate --force` в production (R18).
5. `…000002_rename_storages_to_drives.php` (каждый шаг проверяет состояние до выполнения):
   (a) каждая сущность из устаревшей `vaulter.table_names` с нестандартным именем → `RENAME` в `<prefix><сущность 0.2>`;
   (b) `storages` → `drives`; `panel` → `profile` в `v_drives` и `v_nodes`; `storage_id` → `drive_id` в `v_nodes`, `v_blobs`,
   `v_upload_sessions`, `v_activity`; переименование индексов/FK до имён `SchemaBuilder`;
   (c) удалить `v_drives.{storage_type, slug, default_node_permissions, deleted_at}` и зависимые индексы, создать индексы п.1;
   (d) создать отсутствующие таблицы ядра (ранее выключенные флагами 0.2) через `SchemaBuilder::createTable()`.
50→   `down()`: обратные переименования; удалённые колонки возвращаются с дефолтами 0.2 (`storage_type 'private'`,
   `slug null`, `default_node_permissions 31`, `deleted_at null`) — значения потеряны (UPGRADE.md); таблицы шага (d) не удаляются.
6. `…000004_file_revisions.php`: `file_versions` → `file_revisions` (`version_no` → `number`, `content_sha256` → `sha256`,
   + `declared_mime_type`, `scan_status` = `'not_required'` для существующих строк); `file_version_blobs` → `file_revision_blobs`
   (`file_version_id` → `file_revision_id`, PK/FK); `v_files`: `current_version_id` → `current_revision_id`,
   `version_count` → `revision_count`, удалить `deleted_at`; `v_upload_sessions`: `node_id` → `target_node_id`,
   + `result_node_id`, `result_revision_id` (тип REF по `ids.default`). `down()` — обратно.
7. `…000008_grants_shares_cleanup.php`: `DELETE` grants с `deleted_at IS NOT NULL`; shares:
   `revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, deleted_at)`; удалить `deleted_at` (оба), `inherited`, `inherited_from_node_id`;
   PG — снять частичный unique, MySQL — `grant_active` и его unique; создать обычный unique п.1. `down()` возвращает
60→   колонки (`deleted_at null`, `inherited false`) и прежние уникальности; удалённые grants не восстанавливаются (UPGRADE.md).
8. `…000009_events.php` + значения `EventType` (R7, R10): карта `storage.created→drive.created`, `node.created→folder.created`,
   `version.created→file.revision_added`, `node.force_deleted→node.purged`, `upload_session.{initiated,aborted,expired}→upload.{…}`;
   `UPDATE` `v_activity.verb`, `v_outbox.event`, `v_webhook_deliveries.event`; `v_webhook_endpoints.events` — PHP-цикл
   чанками по 500 (JSON-список, порядок и дубликаты сохраняются); колонки п.1 для `v_activity`/`v_outbox`. `down()` —
   обратная карта и удаление колонок. В `EventType` значения case → канонические (`DriveCreated='drive.created'`, …).
9. Код всех пакетов: таблицы через `Config::table('<канон>')`, атрибуты/связи/запросы — канонические колонки
   (`storage_id`→`drive_id` в `src`/`tests`/factories, `version_no`→`number`, `content_sha256`→`sha256`,
   `current_version_id`→`current_revision_id` для `File`, `version_count`→`revision_count`, `file_version_id`→`file_revision_id`,
   `node_id`→`target_node_id` для `UploadSession`, `panel`→`profile`); `Profile::storageType()/storageTypeKey()` удаляются.
70→   HTTP-ответы и входы сохраняют прежние JSON-ключи (`storage_id`, `version_no`, …) до P6.1 (R19): ресурс отдаёт
   `'storage_id' => $this->drive_id`.
10. Тесты (`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/`, `uses(TestCase::class)` как у P1.7, PG; пропуск без pgsql или `psql`):
    - `Canon03UpgradeTest.php` — для `pgsql-bigint.sql` и `pgsql-ulid.sql`: загрузка (`LoadsV02Fixture`), `migrate --force` →
      успех; числа строк: `v_drives=3`, `v_nodes=40`, `v_files=16`, `v_file_revisions=22`, `v_file_revision_blobs=22`,
      `v_node_grants=3` (5 − 2 soft-deleted), `v_node_shares=4` (у soft-deleted `revoked_at = deleted_at`), `v_activity=72`,
      `v_outbox=68`, `v_webhook_deliveries=4`, `v_webhook_endpoints=1`; ни одного старого значения события в четырёх
      колонках п.8; `owner_id` строки `1,2,3`/три ULID README; `v_file_revisions.number` файла `q1.csv` = 1,2,3;
      `scan_status = 'not_required'` у всех; повторный `migrate` — no-op; `migrate:rollback --step=5` возвращает
      `v_storages` и прежние значения событий; повторный `migrate` снова зелёный.
80→    - `UpgradePreflightTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint-preflight-red.sql` → `migrate` падает с `UpgradePreflightException`, сообщение
      содержит `gone.txt`-счётчик, `Headless`, `vlegacy_storages`; таблицы не переименованы; случаи (d)/(e) — raw `UPDATE`
      поверх `pgsql-bigint.sql`.
    - `LegacyTableNamesUpgradeTest.php` — `pgsql-bigint.sql` + `ALTER TABLE v_nodes RENAME TO v_custom_nodes` и
      `vaulter.table_names.nodes = 'custom_nodes'` → после `migrate` существует `v_nodes`, строк 40.
    - `SchemaParityTest.php` — схема после upgrade каждого дампа = схема fresh `migrate` той же стратегии (колонки, типы,
      nullable, default, имена и столбцы индексов/unique/FK; порядок колонок не сравнивается). Расхождения, существовавшие
      до P2.7 (замер на дереве P2.1), — `artifacts/P2.7/parity-baseline.txt`; P2.7 не добавляет новых и устраняет все на
      затронутых колонках.
    - Fresh на MySQL: `packages/core/tests/Schema/CanonicalSchemaTest.php` — после `migrate` существуют `v_drives`,
90→      `v_file_revisions`, `v_file_revision_blobs`, колонки п.1 и unique grants; нет `v_storages`, `grant_active`.
11. Документация: `UPGRADE.md` (миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9, необратимые шаги, бэкап, карта событий для подписчиков
    webhooks), `CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]`, `docs/guide/{database-compatibility,configuration,webhooks}.md`; golden
    `PublicApiSnapshotTest` (`EventType` значения, `UpgradePreflightException`, `Config::legacyTable`).

**Scope Excluded:** миграции №5, №6 (кроме ссылок п.2), `v_documents`, `v_document_revisions`, `owned_by`, `sequence`,
удаление `v_nodes.{current_version_id,file_id,deleted_at}` (P4.1, P4.7); `v_drives.status` (P4.6); заполнение
`declared_mime_type`/`scan_status` (P3.7), outbox-колонок (P5.1); новые типы событий (P5.2); JSON-ключи REST (P6.1);
`vaulter:upgrade:inspect`, doctor, `drives:recount` (P7); MySQL-upgrade 0.2 (данных 0.2 на MySQL нет — D09).

100→**Inputs:** `plans/2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE/artifacts/P2-design/P2.7-opus.md`;
`audits/2026-09-29-stable-audit/opus/08-data-model-and-migration.md` (§2, §3); `packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php` (producer: P2.1); `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000006_nodes_cleanup.php`; `tests/fixtures/v0.2.0/README.md` (producer: P0.3);
`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/LoadsV02Fixture.php` (producer: P1.7).

**Files:** `packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php`, `packages/core/src/Support/Config.php`, `packages/core/src/Enums/Events/EventType.php`,
`packages/core/src/Exceptions/Schema/UpgradePreflightException.php` (new), `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_06_13_0000{07..22}_*.php`,
`packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_00000{1,2,4,8,9}_*.php` (new), `…_000003/000006/000007_*.php`,
`packages/{core,drive,documents,media,filament}/{src,tests,database}/**` (имена таблиц/колонок, значения событий),
`packages/core/tests/Upgrade/{Canon03UpgradeTest,UpgradePreflightTest,LegacyTableNamesUpgradeTest,SchemaParityTest}.php` (new),
`packages/core/tests/Schema/CanonicalSchemaTest.php` (new), `packages/core/tests/TablePrefix/TablePrefixTest.php`,
110→`artifacts/P2.7/parity-baseline.txt` (new), `packages/core/tests/Arch/__snapshots__/*`, `docs/guide/*.md`, `UPGRADE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

**Required Reads:** 0) `plans/2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE/artifacts/P2-design/P2.7-opus.md` (дословные требования OPUS — исполнить все,
кроме переданных по `note` ledger); 1) `packages/core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php` (producer: P2.1; `defineStorages`…`defineWebhookDeliveries`,
уникальности 1020–1130, гейты 1240–1260); 2) `packages/core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000006_nodes_cleanup.php` (стиль
идемпотентной миграции P1); 3) `packages/core/tests/Upgrade/LoadsV02Fixture.php`; 4) `tests/fixtures/v0.2.0/README.md`;
5) `packages/core/src/Support/Config.php` (840–860); 6) `packages/core/src/Enums/Events/EventType.php` (producer: P2.1).

**Authority:** routine

120→**Implementation Rules:**
- Каждый шаг миграции проверяет состояние (`Schema::hasTable/hasColumn`, `getIndexes`, `getForeignKeys`) до выполнения;
  повтор после падения посередине доходит до конца (MySQL DDL не транзакционен).
- Данные не теряются, кроме перечисленного в UPGRADE.md (hard-delete soft-deleted grants; колонки `slug`, `storage_type`,
  `default_node_permissions`); любая другая потеря — красный item.
- Значения событий меняются только вместе с миграцией №9 (R7): нет промежуточного состояния, где код пишет новые
  значения, а данные — старые.
- `table_names` не используется нигде, кроме `Config::legacyTable()`.
- Если `SchemaParityTest` показывает расхождение вне `parity-baseline.txt`, которое нельзя устранить без изменения
  шага OPUS, — стоп и эскалация.
130→
**Code Guidance:** остатки в коде (ожидаемый вывод пуст):
`grep -rnE "'storage_id'|->storage_id|'version_no'|'content_sha256'|'file_version_id'|'current_version_id'|'version_count'|Config::table\('(storages|file_versions|file_version_blobs)'\)|table_names" packages/*/src packages/*/database | grep -v "Support/Config.php" | grep -v "Http/Resources" | grep -v "Models/Drive/Node.php"`
(исключения: `legacyTable`, JSON-ключи ресурсов R19 и `v_nodes.current_version_id` до P4.1 — по одному обоснованному
совпадению на файл, перечисленному в Completion Notes).

**Validation:**
- Code Guidance → пусто (кроме перечисленных исключений).
- `env $PG scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci packages/core/tests/Upgrade packages/core/tests/Schema` → 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `env $MY scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci packages/core/tests/Schema/CanonicalSchemaTest.php` → 0 failed (падение,
140→  воспроизводимое на дереве P2.1 без изменений P2.7, — finding с владельцем P8.1, как правило MySQL P1.7).
- Сетка P1 на PG → 0 failed, 0 skipped; гейт всех пакетов → exit 0.
- Негативные контроли: (1) убрать `UPDATE … v_webhook_endpoints` из №9 → `Canon03UpgradeTest` красный (старое значение в
  подписке); (2) убрать проверку (a) из preflight → `UpgradePreflightTest` красный; вернуть оба.

**Deliverables:** целевая схема P2 без feature-гейтов; миграции №1, №2, №4, №8, №9; канонические значения `EventType`;
`Config::legacyTable`; тесты upgrade/parity/preflight на фикстуре P0.3; UPGRADE/CHANGELOG/docs/golden.

10→# D18 — P2.7: фактический порядок миграций и сохранение истории

**Actor:** repository owner, текущая Codex-сессия, 2026-10-04.
**Evidence:** владелец ответил «Да, проверяй фактический порядок миграций» на предложение
проверять 72 исторические + 2 ремонтные activity-записи и полный rollback upgrade-batch.
Дополнительное указание: «в плане могут быть недочеты, поэтому всегда полагаемся на реалии».

## Solution

1. Ожидаются 74 activity-записи: все 72 исторические записи сохраняются, а уже принятая
20→   миграция P1 №6 добавляет две записи ремонта вторых корней. Это не потеря истории.
2. Для возврата `v_storages` откатывается весь upgrade-batch. `--step=5` откатывает
   №9, №8, №7, №6, №4 и не достигает переименования №2. Затем повторный upgrade
   снова проверяет сохранение данных и канонические имена.
3. №3 исполняется между №2 и №4: host-key преобразование revisions использует ещё
   существующую историческую таблицу, включая `legacyTable` для нестандартных имён.
4. При свежей установке базовые и upgrade-миграции находятся в одном batch;
   upgrade-down сохраняет канонические имена для последующего base-down. Иначе
   rollback свежей установки оставлял бы переименованные исторические таблицы.
5. Persisted `outbox.panel` переименован в `profile` вместе с его consumers.
30→   Публичные параметры контекста и старые REST-ключи сохраняются до своих пунктов.
6. Флаг node extra-data пока управляет существующей колонкой `extra_data`, а не
   несуществующей `extra`; удаление флага и новый формат относятся к P4.1.

## Why

Миграционная история фикстур содержит уже принятые ремонты P1; проверка буквальных
72 строк и пяти шагов rollback давала бы неверную приёмку. Реальные данные и порядок
миграций сохраняются, а отклонения от frozen spec фиксируются явно.

40→## Limits

Исходный frozen spec и OPUS остаются историческими источниками. Проверки и документация
описывают реальные миграции. Разрешённое самим P2.7 исключение свежей установки MySQL
остаётся за P8.1 при подтверждении той же ошибки на дереве P2.1.
Push, публикация и новые работы вне P2.7 этим решением не разрешаются.

1→# P2.7 — self-check against actual migrations

The frozen item and OPUS are interpreted with accepted D18. PostgreSQL 0.2 upgrade is
the historical-data lane; SQLite/PostgreSQL are verified fresh-install lanes. MySQL
fresh installation retains the specifically permitted P2.1 defect, owned by P8.1.
MySQL 0.2 upgrade is excluded by D09 and is not claimed supported.

## Invariants and evidence

10→- Preserve historical identifiers, values and row ownership through table/column
  renames. Both committed bigint/ULID dumps exercise migrate, no-op migrate,
  replay of every new up, full upgrade-batch rollback and re-upgrade.
  Canon03UpgradeTest checks counts and each historical activity event mapping.
- Schema after either upgrade equals fresh schema for the same strategy: all
  column types/null/default/collation/generation metadata, indexes, named FKs,
  and PostgreSQL expression/predicate SQL. SchemaParityTest passes exactly;
  the measured P2.1 baseline contains zero differences for both fixtures.
- Fail before rename on unsafe legacy nodes/drives/files or revisionless documents.
  UpgradePreflightTest checks direct exception details and full artisan migration
20→  refusal. FixtureTestCase deliberately disables automatic setup migration, so
  unsafe historical fixtures actually reach the intended preflight test.
- Preserve all endpoint subscription elements, ordering, duplicates, wildcard and
  custom names. Only the exact event map changes. Batch size is 500. Historical
  scalar event columns convert in the same migration. Canon03UpgradeTest covers
  the fixture and a deliberately mixed list; the negative control disables only
  the endpoint UPDATE and must fail.
- No feature flag removes a canonical table. Node extra_data remains its actual
  existing flagged column until P4.1. CanonicalSchemaTest covers disabled flags.
- Keep REST storage_id, node_id, panel, version_no and content_sha256 names while
30→  reading canonical attributes. UploadSessionResource maps node_id to
  target_node_id; storage slug/storage_type return null after those columns are
  removed. Drive HTTP tests and MutationContractsTest exercise these shapes.
- A fresh install's rollback must drop the canonical base tables. New migration
  down methods distinguish a fresh batch from a historical upgrade batch using
  migration repository rows on the selected connection. Fresh down does not
  rename tables away from the base migration's dropTable targets.
- №3 runs before №4: historical revisions remain available for host-key conversion,
  including customized names. №2/№4 normalize physical constraints/index names
  and PostgreSQL serial sequence names. LegacyTableNamesUpgradeTest includes
40→  customized nodes and revisions, rollback, and a repeated upgrade.
- IDs.host_keys and P1 root/blob-scope behavior remain effective: declared
  PostgreSQL Upgrade+Schema lane passes without skips; the P1 regression grid
  supplements this with typed host keys, listing, races and CAS checks.

## Known risks

- Fixed: SQLite change() can rebuild partial uniqueness incorrectly. Canonical
  fresh migration №2 is a no-op; a renamed historical profile is changed only
  during the supported PostgreSQL upgrade. Exact parity includes predicates.
50→- Fixed: repeated upload-session index rename could produce target_target_node_id.
  The migration uses complete index names and direct up replay is checked.
- Fixed: Testbench's auto-migration rollback interfered with fixture-owned schemas.
  A dedicated FixtureTestCase only registers paths; each upgrade test owns cleanup.
- Deferred to P8.1: real MySQL fresh install fails with error 1215 while adding
  sibling_active STORED over a cascading parent_id FK. mysql-baseline-classification.json
  reproduces the same SQL on archived P2.1 product bytes and on this candidate.
  No successful full MySQL installation is claimed.
- Deferred to P4.1/P4.7: node current_version_id/file_id/deleted_at and document
  version storage remain historical by explicit scope exclusion.
60→- Deferred to P6.1: REST naming migration. The current JSON keys stay compatible.
- Explicitly irreversible: soft-deleted grants are deleted; dropped metadata and
  inheritance flags cannot be recovered by structural rollback. UPGRADE.md requires
  backup and explains this. Share revocation timestamps are preserved.

## Code Guidance exceptions

The exact search output is code-guidance.txt. Every remaining match belongs here:

| File | Reason |
70→|---|---|
| core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000002_rename_storages_to_drives.php | Reads/removes/restores historical storages/storage_id and historical key names during upgrade/down. |
| core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000003_host_key_columns.php | Before №4, resolve existing historical revisions for host-key conversion. |
| core/database/migrations/2026_10_01_000004_file_revisions.php | Exact old-to-new column/table/index maps and the reverse structural rollback. |
| core/database/migrations/2026_06_13_000023_drop_legacy_docvault_tables.php | Existing explanatory comment, no table_names lookup. |
| core/src/Schema/SchemaBuilder.php | Retained node current_version_id and document version_no schema (P4.1). |
| core/src/Repositories/Drive/NodeStoreRepository.php | Retained node head assignment (P4.1). |
| drive/src/Actions/CopyNodeAction.php | Retained node head assignment (P4.1); file handle uses current_revision_id. |
| drive/src/Actions/UploadFileAction.php | Retained node head assignment (P4.1); file handle uses current_revision_id. |
| documents/src/Actions/Collaboration/PersistYjsSnapshotAction.php | Retained document version_no and node head storage (P4.1). |
80→| documents/src/Actions/Documents/CreateDocumentNodeAction.php | Retained document version_no and node head storage (P4.1). |
| documents/src/Actions/Documents/UpdateDocumentContentAction.php | Retained document version_no and node head storage (P4.1). |
| documents/src/Actions/Versions/CreateNamedVersionAction.php | Retained document version_no and node head storage (P4.1). |
| documents/src/Actions/Versions/RestoreDocumentVersionAction.php | Retained document version_no and node head storage (P4.1). |
| documents/src/Http/Controllers/NodeCollaborationController.php | Existing document response/storage version_no (P4.1). |
| documents/src/Repositories/Versions/NodeDocumentVersionStoreRepository.php | Existing document version_no queries (P4.1). |
| documents/src/Repositories/Versions/NodeDocumentVersionReadRepository.php | Existing document version_no queries (P4.1). |
| documents/src/Models/Versions/NodeDocumentVersion.php | Existing document version_no cast (P4.1). |

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Enums\Events;

use Vaulter\Attributes\Label;
use Vaulter\Support\Concerns\HasLabel;

/**
 * The audit verb vocabulary written to v_activity (master plan §2.9 /
 * M2c-activity). Each domain event maps to EXACTLY one verb; the verb is the
 * (verb, created_at desc) feed-filter axis. Dotted, namespaced values
 * (folder.created, file.uploaded, …) keep the feed legible and stable for hosts.
 *
 * The map event → verb is owned by the ActivityRecorder; this enum is the closed
 * set of values it may write.
 */
enum EventType: string
{
    use HasLabel;

    #[Label('Storage created')]
    case DriveCreated = 'drive.created';

    #[Label('Node created')]
    case FolderCreated = 'folder.created';

    #[Label('File uploaded')]
    case FileUploaded = 'file.uploaded';

    #[Label('Version created')]
    case FileRevisionAdded = 'file.revision_added';

    #[Label('Upload session initiated')]
    case UploadInitiated = 'upload.initiated';

    #[Label('Upload session aborted')]
    case UploadAborted = 'upload.aborted';

    #[Label('Upload session expired')]
    case UploadExpired = 'upload.expired';

    #[Label('Node moved')]
    case NodeMoved = 'node.moved';

    #[Label('Node renamed')]
    case NodeRenamed = 'node.renamed';

    #[Label('Node copied')]
    case NodeCopied = 'node.copied';

    #[Label('Node trashed')]
    case NodeTrashed = 'node.trashed';

    #[Label('Node restored')]
    case NodeRestored = 'node.restored';

    #[Label('Node permanently deleted')]
    case NodePurged = 'node.purged';

    #[Label('Grant created')]
    case GrantCreated = 'grant.created';

    #[Label('Grant revoked')]
    case GrantRevoked = 'grant.revoked';

    #[Label('Share created')]
    case ShareCreated = 'share.created';

    #[Label('Share revoked')]
    case ShareRevoked = 'share.revoked';

    /** @return list<self> */
    public static function webhookTypes(): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(self::cases(), static fn (self $type): bool => !in_array(
            $type,
            [self::UploadInitiated, self::UploadAborted, self::UploadExpired],
            true,
        )));
    }

    /** @return list<string> */
    public static function names(): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (self $type): string => $type->value, self::webhookTypes());
    }
}

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: user:docs
availableCommands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached.

        $this->convert(restore: true);
    }

    private function convert(bool $restore): void
    {
        $connection = app(VaulterDatabase::class)->connection();
        $driver = $connection->getDriverName();

        if ($driver === 'sqlite') {
            return;
        }

        $schema = $connection->getSchemaBuilder();
        $grammar = $connection->getQueryGrammar();

        foreach (self::COLUMNS as $entity => $columns) {
            $table = Config::table($entity);
            // #3 precedes the revision-table rename in #4, including on rollback.
            if ($entity === 'file_revisions' && !$schema->hasTable($table)) {
                $table = $schema->hasTable(Config::table('file_versions')) ? Config::table('file_versions') : Config::legacyTable('file_versions');
            }

            if (!$schema->hasTable($table)) {
                continue;
            }

            $actual = array_column($schema->getColumns($table), null, 'name');

            foreach ($columns as $column => $nullable) {
                if (!isset($actual[$column])) {
                    continue;
                }

                $type = $restore
                    ? $this->originalType(new Blueprint($connection, $table), $entity, $column, $driver)
                    : HostKeyColumns::sqlType($driver);

                // type_name alone cannot distinguish varchar(26) from varchar(64)
                // or a signed bigint from an unsigned MySQL bigint.
                $actualType = str_replace(['character varying', 'character'], ['varchar', 'char'], strtolower($actual[$column]['type']));
                if ($actualType === $type) {
                    continue;
                }

                $wrappedTable = $grammar->wrapTable($table);
                $wrappedColumn = $grammar->wrap($column);

                if ($driver === 'pgsql') {
                    $cast = match ($type) {
                        'bigint' => 'bigint',
                        'uuid' => 'uuid',
                        default => 'text',
                    };
                    $connection->statement("ALTER TABLE {$wrappedTable} ALTER COLUMN {$wrappedColumn} TYPE {$type} USING {$wrappedColumn}::{$cast}");
                } else {
                    $null = $nullable ? 'NULL' : 'NOT NULL';
                    $connection->statement("ALTER TABLE {$wrappedTable} MODIFY {$wrappedColumn} {$type} {$null}");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private function originalType(Blueprint $blueprint, string $entity, string $column, string $driver): string
    {
        $strategy = app(IdStrategyResolver::class)->resolve();
        $reference = $column === 'tenant_id'
            || ($entity === 'drives' && $column === 'owner_id')
            || $column === 'subject_id'
            || $column === 'author_id';

        if ($reference) {
            $strategy->reference($blueprint, $column);
        } else {
            $strategy->actor($blueprint, $column);
        }

        $definition = $blueprint->getColumns()[0];
        $type = $definition->get('type');
        $length = $definition->get('length');

        if (!is_string($type) || (in_array($type, ['char', 'string'], true) && !is_int($length))) {
            throw new LogicException('[Vaulter] Invalid rollback host-key definition.');
        }

        return match ($type) {
            'bigInteger' => $driver !== 'pgsql' && $definition->get('unsigned') ? 'bigint unsigned' : 'bigint',
            'char' => 'char('.$length.')',
            'string' => 'varchar('.$length.')',
            'uuid' => $driver === 'pgsql' ? 'uuid' : 'char(36)',
            default => throw new LogicException('[Vaulter] Unsupported rollback host-key type ['.$type.'].'),
        };
    }
};

1→# v0.2.0 data fixture

Database dumps of a Vaulter **0.2.0** install holding every data shape the 0.2 → 0.3 upgrade migrations
(OPUS 08 §3) must carry over or refuse. Consumers: V15 (upgrade on the fixture), V14 (`repair-scopes` on
`legacy:snull`), upgrade migrations №1 (preflight), №5 (documents, every `format`), №6 (N04 «second roots»),
№7 (`scope_key`), №8 (soft-deleted grants/shares).

Generated from `v0.2.0` (`983c345c1088363a1f52c6b44096f4e82c6a2cd4`): the tag's own core migrations and the tag's
API/models (`scripts/fixtures/seed-v0.2.php`), run from a `git worktree` of the tag — never the current code.
10→
## Regenerate / verify

```bash
scripts/fixtures/make-v0.2-dump.sh            # rewrite the dumps + SHA256SUMS (recreates the *_test schema)
scripts/fixtures/make-v0.2-dump.sh --verify   # regenerate into a temp dir, compare SHA256SUMS, load, count
FIXTURE_CONFIGS=pgsql-bigint scripts/fixtures/make-v0.2-dump.sh --verify   # one configuration
```

Prerequisites: `scripts/db-preflight.sh pgsql` exit 0 (D04), PHP 8.4 via `scripts/php84`. The worktree
20→`build/fixtures/v0.2.0` is created and `composer install`ed on first run (`build/` is not committed); the script
refuses a worktree whose HEAD is not `v0.2.0` or that has tracked edits. The tag has no `composer.lock`, so the
resolved stack is recorded here: laravel/framework v13.34.0, orchestra/testbench v11.3.0 (core v11.5.0),
spatie/laravel-package-tools 1.93.3 — a different resolution may change the dumps and fail `--verify`.
Two consecutive runs produce byte-identical files: frozen clock, counter-based ULID/UUID/random-string
factories, fixed bytes, a content-derived encryption IV, `pg_dump --restrict-key`; the DB-clock default
`v_blobs.first_seen_at` is pinned to `committed_at` by the seeder.

Tool: `pg_dump` 16.15 (the server's major, not the `pg_wrapper` default),
`--no-owner --no-privileges --no-comments --inserts --rows-per-insert=100 --quote-all-identifiers`.
30→The dump header names the exact `pg_dump` build, so `--verify` is byte-exact only on PostgreSQL 16.15 — a local
maintenance check, not a CI gate. Loading needs `psql` ≥ 16.10 (`\restrict`); `--verify` also checks the committed
files against `SHA256SUMS` (`sha256sum -c`).

## Configurations

| Dump | Status |
|:--|:--|
| `pgsql-bigint.sql` | generated |
| `pgsql-ulid.sql` | generated |
40→| `pgsql-bigint-preflight-red.sql` | generated |

Feature flags at seed time: `document_versions`, `share_links`, `comments` on (the document version table
exists only with `document_versions`); tenancy off; host-key strategy = the dump's `bigint`/`ulid`.

## Composition (each main dump)

| Shape | Count | Rows | For |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| storages of three owners (`owner_type = fixture_host`); bigint `owner_id` `1,2,3`; ulid `01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV/W/X` | 3 | `v_storages` | №2, №3; arbitrary string HK — P1.7/V23 |
50→| tree per storage: root, `Projects`, `Projects/Reports 2025`, `Projects/2025` (moved), `Archive`, files, `old.txt` in trash, `Temp/` folder in trash | 10 nodes/storage | `v_nodes` | №6, AD27 |
| files with 1 version (`brief.txt`, `old.txt`, `note.txt`, `*.bin`) and 3 versions (`q1.csv`) | 16 files, 22 versions | `v_files`, `v_file_versions` | №4, V03 |
| `legacy:snull`: `dedup_scope=storage`, `storage_id NULL` (brief.txt of storage 1) | 1 | `v_blobs` | №7, V14 |
| `legacy:tnull`: `dedup_scope=tenant`, `tenant_id NULL` (tenancy off) | 2 | `v_blobs` | №7, V14 |
| one blob shared by two storages (`shared.bin` in storages 2 and 3) | 1 | `v_blobs` | №7, V14 |
| `dedup_scope=global` blob (`global.bin`, storage 1) | 1 | `v_blobs` | №7 (`global`) |
| documents of every 0.2 `DocumentType`: `richtext` (Notes, 2 versions), `table` (Budget), `markdown` (Readme, 2 versions), `template` (Letter template) | 4 | `v_nodes`, `v_node_document_versions` | №5 |
| N04 «second roots»: documents with `parent_id NULL` — `Loose note` and `Projects` (name clash with the root's `Projects` folder) | 2 | `v_nodes` | №6 N04 repair |
| grants on `Projects`: active user + role, soft-deleted (`deleted_at`) user + role, and an active re-grant of the soft-deleted user | 5 | `v_node_grants` | №8 (hard delete, uniqueness rebuild) |
| shares on `brief.txt`: active, revoked (`revoked_at`), soft-deleted (`deleted_at`), revoked then soft-deleted | 4 | `v_node_shares` | №8 (`coalesce(revoked_at, deleted_at)`) |
60→| activity: create, upload, version, rename, move, trash, restore, grant, share, upload-session | 72 | `v_activity` | №9, P5 |
| outbox: relayed (`dispatched`) and `pending`; webhook endpoint + 4 delivered deliveries | 68 / 1 / 4 | `v_outbox`, `v_webhook_*` | №9, P5 |
| tus upload in progress (`uploading`, 4 of 10 bytes) | 1 | `v_upload_sessions` | P3.7 |

Raw SQL only where the 0.2 API never produces the shape (each marked `raw:` in the seeder): `legacy:snull`
(0.2 always stamps the uploading storage), the DB-clock `first_seen_at`, and the preflight-red rows below.
The N04 second roots, `legacy:tnull`, soft-deleted grants/shares come from the 0.2 API itself.

`pgsql-bigint-preflight-red.sql` holds only the shapes that make preflight №1 refuse, one of each (negative test
in P2.1): a node with `v_nodes.deleted_at` set (`gone.txt`), a document node without version rows (`Headless`),
70→and own tables of a storage panel (`vlegacy_storages`, one row). These shapes are absent from the main dumps.

## Row counts (`--verify` compares these lines)

```text
pgsql-bigint.sql: migrations=19 v_activity=72 v_blobs=21 v_file_version_blobs=22 v_file_versions=22 v_files=16 v_node_comments=0 v_node_document_versions=8 v_node_grants=5 v_node_shares=4 v_nodes=40 v_outbox=68 v_storages=3 v_upload_parts=0 v_upload_sessions=1 v_webhook_deliveries=4 v_webhook_endpoints=1 owners=1,2,3
pgsql-ulid.sql: migrations=19 v_activity=72 v_blobs=21 v_file_version_blobs=22 v_file_versions=22 v_files=16 v_node_comments=0 v_node_document_versions=8 v_node_grants=5 v_node_shares=4 v_nodes=40 v_outbox=68 v_storages=3 v_upload_parts=0 v_upload_sessions=1 v_webhook_deliveries=4 v_webhook_endpoints=1 owners=01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV,01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAW,01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAX
pgsql-bigint-preflight-red.sql: migrations=19 v_activity=3 v_blobs=1 v_file_version_blobs=1 v_file_versions=1 v_files=1 v_node_comments=0 v_node_document_versions=0 v_node_grants=0 v_node_shares=0 v_nodes=4 v_outbox=3 v_storages=1 v_upload_parts=0 v_upload_sessions=0 v_webhook_deliveries=0 v_webhook_endpoints=0 vlegacy_storages=1 owners=1
```

80→## MySQL

`v0.2.0` cannot be installed on MySQL 8.0 (checked on 8.0.46): its nodes migration adds the STORED generated
column `v_nodes.sibling_active` over `parent_id`, whose foreign key is `ON DELETE CASCADE`; MySQL rejects that
(`SQLSTATE[HY000] 1215 Cannot add foreign key constraint`, `PanelTablesBuilder.php:1139` at the tag). The tag's
CI had no MySQL job, so 0.2 data on MySQL cannot exist and the fixture is PostgreSQL-only (PLAN2 D09). The 0.2 → 0.3
upgrade is proven on these PostgreSQL dumps; MySQL support of 0.3 is proven from a fresh 0.3 install.

`v0.2.0` cannot be installed on MySQL 8.0 (checked on 8.0.46): its nodes migration adds the STORED generated
column `v_nodes.sibling_active` over `parent_id`, whose foreign key is `ON DELETE CASCADE`; MySQL rejects that
(`SQLSTATE[HY000] 1215 Cannot add foreign key constraint`, `PanelTablesBuilder.php:1139` at the tag). The tag's
CI had no MySQL job, so 0.2 data on MySQL cannot exist and the fixture is PostgreSQL-only (PLAN2 D09). The 0.2 → 0.3
upgrade is proven on these PostgreSQL dumps; MySQL support of 0.3 is proven from a fresh 0.3 install.

Database dumps of a Vaulter **0.2.0** install holding every data shape the 0.2 → 0.3 upgrade migrations
(OPUS 08 §3) must carry over or refuse. Consumers: V15 (upgrade on the fixture), V14 (`repair-scopes` on
`legacy:snull`), upgrade migrations №1 (preflight), №5 (documents, every `format`), №6 (N04 «second roots»),
№7 (`scope_key`), №8 (soft-deleted grants/shares).

Generated from `v0.2.0` (`983c345c1088363a1f52c6b44096f4e82c6a2cd4`): the tag's own core migrations and the tag's
API/models (`scripts/fixtures/seed-v0.2.php`), run from a `git worktree` of the tag — never the current code.

## Regenerate / verify

```bash
scripts/fixtures/make-v0.2-dump.sh            # rewrite the dumps + SHA256SUMS (recreates the *_test schema)
scripts/fixtures/make-v0.2-dump.sh --verify   # regenerate into a temp dir, compare SHA256SUMS, load, count
FIXTURE_CONFIGS=pgsql-bigint scripts/fixtures/make-v0.2-dump.sh --verify   # one configuration
```

Prerequisites: `scripts/db-preflight.sh pgsql` exit 0 (D04), PHP 8.4 via `scripts/php84`. The worktree
`build/fixtures/v0.2.0` is created and `composer install`ed on first run (`build/` is not committed); the script
refuses a worktree whose HEAD is not `v0.2.0` or that has tracked edits. The tag has no `composer.lock`, so the
resolved stack is recorded here: laravel/framework v13.34.0, orchestra/testbench v11.3.0 (core v11.5.0),
spatie/laravel-package-tools 1.93.3 — a different resolution may change the dumps and fail `--verify`.
Two consecutive runs produce byte-identical files: frozen clock, counter-based ULID/UUID/random-string
factories, fixed bytes, a content-derived encryption IV, `pg_dump --restrict-key`; the DB-clock default
`v_blobs.first_seen_at` is pinned to `committed_at` by the seeder.

Tool: `pg_dump` 16.15 (the server's major, not the `pg_wrapper` default),
`--no-owner --no-privileges --no-comments --inserts --rows-per-insert=100 --quote-all-identifiers`.
The dump header names the exact `pg_dump` build, so `--verify` is byte-exact only on PostgreSQL 16.15 — a local
maintenance check, not a CI gate. Loading needs `psql` ≥ 16.10 (`\restrict`); `--verify` also checks the committed
files against `SHA256SUMS` (`sha256sum -c`).

есть и в таблице `activity`.

Таблица `nodes` содержит
и `_panel_`, но они не пересекаются, поэтому

не может оставаться.

Проверяю, не останется

— миграция №4 её удаляет.

Свежая схема таблицы
так как в ней не применяется

корректно отличается от нового `v_storages`, поэтому совпадение исключается. Информационная схема обычно фильтрует системные таблицы.

Обнаружен баг в префлайте: при использовании алиаса `as n` в `from()` Laravel может обернуть всю строку `v_nodes as n` в кавычки как единый идентификатор. Это приведёт к ошибке SQL.

        if (!$schema->hasIndex($name, $name.'_scope_sha_uniq')) {

        }
    }

    private function identifier(mixed $id): string

        if (!$schema->hasIndex($name, $name.'_dedup_uniq')) {
            $columns = match (Config::dedupScope()) {

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Vaulter\Support\Config;

/**
 * F-P4.1-01 / F-P4.1-02 (VLT-REMED P4.3, batch B16): the trashed_at scan index
 * `vaulter:purge-trash`'s predicate needs — without it every scheduled run is a
 * full v_nodes seq-scan (findings/P4.1-query-indexes.md C5) — plus removal of
 * three indexes whose column set is a strict prefix (v_nodes, v_blobs) or a
 * literal duplicate (v_activity) of another index already on the same table
 * (§0/C7): dead write cost, zero read benefit.
 *
 * A fresh install already gets the corrected shape straight from
 * SchemaBuilder (defineNodes/defineBlobs/defineActivity + the new
 * addTrashedAtIndex() hook no longer double-emit), so every step below first
 * inspects Schema::getIndexes() — this migration only does real work against a
 * database that ran the OLD shape before this fix shipped; re-running it (or
 * running it against a fresh install) is a no-op. Applied migrations are never
 * rewritten (package-migrations rule) — this is a NEW migration, not an edit of
 * one of the 2026_06_13_* shells.
 */
return new class extends Migration
{
    public function up(): void
    {
        $this->addTrashedAtIndexIfMissing();
        $this->dropIndexByColumnsIfPresent(table: Config::table('nodes'), columns: ['drive_id', 'parent_id']);
        $this->dropIndexByColumnsIfPresent(table: Config::table('blobs'), columns: ['status']);
        $this->dropDuplicateActivityCreatedAtIndex();
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        $this->restoreIndexByColumnsIfMissing(table: Config::table('nodes'), columns: ['drive_id', 'parent_id']);
        $this->restoreIndexByColumnsIfMissing(table: Config::table('blobs'), columns: ['status']);
        $this->restoreActivityCreatedAtIndexIfMissing();
        $this->dropTrashedAtIndexIfPresent();
    }

    private function addTrashedAtIndexIfMissing(): void
    {
        $table = Config::table('nodes');

        if (!Schema::hasTable($table) || $this->hasIndexOnColumns($table, ['trashed_at'])) {
            return;
        }

        $name = $table.'_trashed_idx';
        $driver = Schema::getConnection()->getDriverName();

        if ($driver === 'pgsql' || $driver === 'sqlite') {
            DB::statement(sprintf('CREATE INDEX %s ON %s (trashed_at) WHERE trashed_at IS NOT NULL', $name, $table));

            return;
        }

        Schema::table($table, static function (Blueprint $blueprint) use ($name): void {
            $blueprint->index('trashed_at', $name);
        });
    }

    private function dropTrashedAtIndexIfPresent(): void
    {
        $table = Config::table('nodes');
        $index = $this->findIndexByColumns($table, ['trashed_at']);

        if (!Schema::hasTable($table) || $index === null) {
            return;
        }

        Schema::table($table, static function (Blueprint $blueprint) use ($index): void {
            $blueprint->dropIndex($index['name']);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Drop a plain btree index whose column set is EXACTLY $columns — matched by
     * column set, not by name, because the index in question is Laravel's own
     * default-named one (no explicit name was ever given to it).
     *
     * @param list<string> $columns
     */
    private function dropIndexByColumnsIfPresent(string $table, array $columns): void
    {
        $index = $this->findIndexByColumns($table, $columns);

        if (!Schema::hasTable($table) || $index === null) {
            return;
        }

        Schema::table($table, static function (Blueprint $blueprint) use ($index): void {
            $blueprint->dropIndex($index['name']);
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $columns
     */
    private function restoreIndexByColumnsIfMissing(string $table, array $columns): void
    {
        if (!Schema::hasTable($table) || $this->hasIndexOnColumns($table, $columns)) {
            return;
        }

        Schema::table($table, static function (Blueprint $blueprint) use ($columns): void {
            $blueprint->index($columns);
        });
    }

    /**
     * v_activity carries created_at TWICE on a pre-fix database — an unnamed
     * inline index and the explicit `_created_idx`
     * (SchemaBuilder::addActivityCreatedAtIndex). Keep the named one (every
     * other feed index on this table already follows the `_xxx_idx` convention),
     * drop the other.
     */
    private function dropDuplicateActivityCreatedAtIndex(): void
    {
        $table = Config::table('activity');

        if (!Schema::hasTable($table)) {
            return;
        }

        $keep = $table.'_created_idx';

        foreach ($this->indexesOnColumns($table, ['created_at']) as $index) {
            if ($index['name'] === $keep) {
                continue;
            }

            Schema::table($table, static function (Blueprint $blueprint) use ($index): void {
                $blueprint->dropIndex($index['name']);
            });
        }
    }

    private function restoreActivityCreatedAtIndexIfMissing(): void
    {
        $table = Config::table('activity');

        if (!Schema::hasTable($table) || count($this->indexesOnColumns($table, ['created_at'])) >= 2) {
            return;
        }

        Schema::table($table, static function (Blueprint $blueprint): void {
            $blueprint->index('created_at');
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $columns
     */
    private function hasIndexOnColumns(string $table, array $columns): bool
    {
        return $this->findIndexByColumns($table, $columns) !== null;
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>                                    $columns
     * @return array{name: string, columns: list<string>}|null
     */
    private function findIndexByColumns(string $table, array $columns): ?array
    {
        foreach ($this->indexes($table) as $index) {
            if ($index['columns'] === $columns) {
                return $index;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<string>                                     $columns
     * @return list<array{name: string, columns: list<string>}>
     */
    private function indexesOnColumns(string $table, array $columns): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter(
            $this->indexes($table),
            static fn (array $index): bool => $index['columns'] === $columns,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{name: string, columns: list<string>}>
     */
    private function indexes(string $table): array
    {
        /** @var list<array{name: string, columns: list<string>}> $indexes */
        $indexes = Schema::getIndexes($table);

        return $indexes;
    }
};

На MySQL unsigned и signed различаются между свежей схемой и upgrade, но upgrade для MySQL исключён. Свежая схема использует unsignedInteger, поэтому это не проблема.

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Models\Activity\Activity;
use Vaulter\Schema\SchemaBuilder;
use Vaulter\Support\Config;
use Vaulter\Support\Identity;

/**
 * Before 0.3 an Action could write a node with no parent outside the drive root: a
 * second root, missing from the root listing and outside sibling-name uniqueness.
 * Each such node is moved under its drive's root (renamed "<base> (legacy N)<.ext>"
 * when a live root child already owns the name), every move is written to the
 * activity log, and the one-root-per-drive index is added. Idempotent: a re-run
 * finds nothing to move and the index in place. The moves are not undone by down().

{
    /** The width of the nodes name column (varchar(255)). */
    private const int NAME_MAX_BYTES = 255;

    public function up(): void
    {

        $nodes = Config::table('nodes');

        if (!$connection->getSchemaBuilder()->hasTable($nodes)) {
            return;
        }

        $connection->transaction(function () use ($connection, $nodes): void {
            $this->refuseUnknownRoots($connection, $nodes);
            $this->repairSecondRoots($connection, $nodes);
        });

        $connection = app(VaulterDatabase::class)->connection();

            return;
        }

        if ($schema->hasIndex($nodes, $this->indexName($nodes))) {

        }

        if ($schema->hasColumn($nodes, 'root_storage')) {
            $schema->table($nodes, static fn (Blueprint $table) => $table->dropColumn('root_storage'));
        }
    }

    /**
     * A drive without a recorded root cannot be repaired by guessing which of its
     * parentless nodes is the root; stop before changing anything.
     */
    private function refuseUnknownRoots(Connection $connection, string $nodes): void
    {
        $ambiguous = $connection->table($nodes.' as n')
            ->join(Config::table('drives').' as s', 's.id', '=', 'n.drive_id')
            ->whereNull('n.parent_id')
            ->whereNull('s.root_node_id')
            ->groupBy('n.drive_id')
            ->havingRaw('count(*) > 1')
            ->pluck('n.drive_id')
            ->all();

        if ($ambiguous !== []) {
            throw new RuntimeException(
                '[Vaulter] Storages ['.implode(', ', array_map(Identity::stringify(...), $ambiguous)).'] have several parentless nodes '
                .'and no root_node_id. Fix: set root_node_id to the real root folder of each, then run the migration again.',
            );
        }
    }

    private function repairSecondRoots(Connection $connection, string $nodes): void
    {
        $orphans = $connection->table($nodes.' as n')
            ->join(Config::table('drives').' as s', 's.id', '=', 'n.drive_id')
            ->whereNull('n.parent_id')
            ->whereNotNull('s.root_node_id')
            ->whereColumn('n.id', '<>', 's.root_node_id')
            ->orderBy('n.drive_id')
            ->orderBy('n.id')
            ->get(['n.id', 'n.tenant_id', 'n.drive_id', 'n.name', 'n.trashed_at', 'n.deleted_at', 's.root_node_id']);

            $rootId = $this->key($orphan->root_node_id);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Schema;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Concerns\HasUlids;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Vaulter\Contracts\IdStrategy;

/**
 * Lexicographically sortable ULID keys (26-char Crockford base32). The default
 * strategy (D9) — its morph keys line up with the Corex/Azgard ecosystem.
 */
final class UlidIds implements IdStrategy
{
    public function key(Blueprint $table, string $column = 'id'): void
    {
        // Declare the PRIMARY KEY as an explicit command at key() time rather than a
        // fluent ->primary() modifier. Laravel appends fluent indexes LAST (after the
        // table's foreign-key commands), so on PostgreSQL a SELF-referencing FK added in
        // the same create (v_nodes.parent_id → v_nodes.id) would be compiled BEFORE the
        // PK and rejected with "no unique constraint matching given keys". An explicit
        // command keeps the PK ahead of the foreign keys. (bigIncrements is immune — its
        // PK is inlined into CREATE TABLE.)
        $table->char(column: $column, length: 26);
        $table->primary($column);
    }

    public function reference(Blueprint $table, string $column, bool $nullable = false): void
    {
        $table->char(column: $column, length: 26)->nullable(value: $nullable)->index();
    }

    public function actor(Blueprint $table, string $column, bool $nullable = false): void
    {
        $table->char(column: $column, length: 26)->nullable(value: $nullable);
    }

    public function cast(): string
    {
        return 'string';
    }

    /**
     * @return class-string
     */
    public function modelConcern(): string
    {
        return HasUlids::class;
    }

    public function newId(): string
    {
        return (string) Str::ulid();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Schema;

use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Vaulter\Contracts\IdStrategy;

/**
 * Classic auto-incrementing bigint keys (legacy id_type=id). References and
 * actors carry the matching unsigned-bigint type; the database assigns the
 * value, so no model concern and no generated key are needed.
 */
final class AutoIncrementIds implements IdStrategy
{
    public function key(Blueprint $table, string $column = 'id'): void
    {
        $table->bigIncrements(column: $column);
    }

    public function reference(Blueprint $table, string $column, bool $nullable = false): void
    {
        $table->unsignedBigInteger(column: $column)->nullable(value: $nullable)->index();
    }

    public function actor(Blueprint $table, string $column, bool $nullable = false): void
    {
        $table->unsignedBigInteger(column: $column)->nullable(value: $nullable);
    }

    public function cast(): string
    {
        return 'integer';
    }

    public function modelConcern(): ?string
    {
        return null;
    }

    public function newId(): string|int|null
    {
        return null;
    }
}
